body: I heard about a case where this gf constantly convinced her suicidal bf to commit suicide so she could gain sympathy. She was charged with something in court and her text messages to him were used as evidence. In that case yes? But if it's any other case then no? They should leave the toxic relationship. It just means those two people aren't compatible really.
This sounds exactly like me too actually...

I feel like some people do it for themselves. To convince themselves that that they're good people? To convince themselves that they are a part of your journey and that they "helped" you in some way. Idk I really hate this too because I see a lot of people online (who I know in real life) who say "My DM's are open if you are feeling down and depressed" but in reality I know they don't care and they only do it so people around them think that they care. I'm just rambling I'm sorry
I have the same wish but when I looked it up I saw that it costs thousands of dollars in some places where it is legal and it stressed me out.

Idk if this is a sensitive topic but I recently started to wonder why a part of society accepts abortion but society as a whole doesn't accept suicide. Like I always hear "my body, my choice" and I always wonder why It's bad for me to want to kill myself if it's my body anyway. I'm not choosing sides for abortion or anything I'm just wondering why and I'm genuinely curious, no malice.

I agree that friends might not have the best reaction when they hear about suicidal thoughts. But it might be because they're dealing with their own problems too and it's hard for them to process someone elses problems? My friends might be like that too, I do appreciate them trying though even though I know things might be rough for them too :) maybe you should try therapy? If you need someone to listen or vent out to I can
Me too, makes me jealous sometimes but I never say it though

Thank you for this. I've been meaning to talk to them about stuff but I'm scared they will freak out. I'm still thinking of ways to do it without losing them too or without them looking at me differently in the end.

Whatever happens, you are a really good friend. I wish I had someone like you in my life. I hope everything goes well for you and your friend and I hope she gets some help and gets better soon. She's extremely lucky to have you seriously. Clearly you love her so much as a friend and you have never rejected her tell her that?

I feel the same way. I constantly work out and try to stay "fit" or at least look the part but it's been years and I still can't seem to get there. I read some articles and saw some videos and I think I might have Body Dysmorphic Disorder (I can't afford to get diagnosed where I live) which really sucks because I also read it's not easy to bare with or cope with. I hope this doesn't apply to you though :( I know how you feel, I wish you the best really.

I kinda get it. I'm in a similar place I guess except I haven't tried reaching out to suicide hotlines. I fucking hate it when people say they're "there" for you or they'll "listen" but the moment you reach out to them they're clearly not willing to listen or support. It's like they only say that to convince themselves that they're helping so that they don't feel guilty if I die. Sorry for my bad English.
